title: Patch
description: An agent's proposed changes, staged at inbox/staged/<timestamp>.patch.json. Applied all or nothing by npm run inbox:apply, which refuses everything if validation fails afterwards.

updates.description: Shallow field replacement on an existing record. Cannot create, and cannot delete a record; section 13.4 forbids deletion outright.

notes.description: What the agent inferred and why, in plain language.

uncertain.description: Questions the agent could not answer. Each becomes a line in suggestions/ rather than a silent guess.
